rules.dep_exact: called("deposit") and ok and post("reserves") != pre("reserves") + arg(0)
rules.wd_exact: called("withdraw") and ok and post("reserves") + arg(0) != pre("reserves")
rules.breaker: ok and pre("paused") != 0 and post("paused") == 0 and post("reserves") < 10
rules.unpause_works: called("unpause") and reverted and (sender == pre("guardian") and pre("reserves") >= 10)
rules.trips: called("withdraw") and ok and post("reserves") < 10 and post("paused") == 0
rules.auth_unpause: ok and sender != pre("guardian") and pre("paused") != 0 and post("paused") == 0
rules.no_trip_early: called("withdraw") and ok and post("reserves") >= 10 and pre("paused") == 0 and post("paused") != 0
